claims: Wisconsin defeated Harvard 64-61 in overtime on March 26, 2026
The game was during the WBIT Quarterfinals
The game was at the Kohl Center in Madison
Wisconsin overcame a late fourth-quarter deficit to advance to the semifinals
Abigail Wright scored 18 points for Harvard
Harvard held a 23-14 lead in the second quarter
Wisconsin forced overtime after a late fourth-quarter comeback
Gift Uchenna Okeke led Wisconsin with 17 points
Kyrah Daniels scored 15 points for Wisconsin
Abigail Wright recorded a double-double with 18 points and 11 rebounds for Harvard
Yahoo Sports reported that Wisconsin held Harvard to 32.8% shooting
Yahoo Sports reported that Wisconsin forced 18 turnovers from Harvard
Ronnie Porter made a crucial charge call in the final seconds
The win continued Wisconsin's home-court run in the WBIT Tournament
